# SwiftEx Wallet
> SwiftEx Wallet is a non-custodial crypto wallet for managing digital assets across supported blockchain networks. Send, receive, swap, bridge, and access fiat via licensed third-party partners — with transparent fees.

## What is SwiftEx Wallet
SwiftEx Wallet is a secure, self-custodial mobile application available on Android and iOS. It allows users to fully manage their digital assets across multiple supported blockchain networks from a single app. SwiftEx does not hold user funds, does not store private keys, and does not operate as a financial service, brokerage, or custodian of any kind. All fiat-related features are provided exclusively by licensed and regulated third-party partners.

## Core Features
- Non-custodial — users retain full ownership of private keys and recovery phrase at all times
- Multi-wallet support — import existing wallets or create new ones, all in one place
- Send and receive digital assets across supported networks
- Cross-chain bridging — move assets between supported blockchain networks
- Token swaps via Stellar SDEX — on-chain swaps with typically low network fees
- Fiat on/off-ramp — buy and sell crypto via licensed third-party providers
- Transparent fees — no hidden platform fees for core wallet and asset management features
- Clean, intuitive interface built for both beginners and experienced crypto users
- Advanced encryption and security standards
- No personal data tracking — user activity is never shared with third parties

## Supported Platforms
- Android: Available on Google Play and as a direct APK download
- iOS: Available on the App Store
- Web: Web app available

## Frequently Asked Questions

**Is SwiftEx Wallet safe?**
Yes. SwiftEx is non-custodial — your private keys and recovery phrase never leave your device. SwiftEx has no access to your funds.

**Does SwiftEx charge fees?**
SwiftEx has transparent fees — no hidden platform fees for core wallet features. Network (gas) fees set by the blockchain still apply. Third-party partners for fiat on/off-ramp may have their own fees.

**Which blockchains are supported?**
SwiftEx supports multiple blockchain networks with cross-chain bridging. Check the wallet features page for the current list: https://swiftexwallet.com/swiftex-wallet

**Is SwiftEx available on iPhone?**
Yes, available on the App Store: https://apps.apple.com/app/swiftex-wallet/id6759080930

**What happens if I lose my phone?**
Your funds are recoverable using your recovery phrase. SwiftEx does not store or have access to it — keep it safe offline.

**Is SwiftEx regulated?**
SwiftEx is a non-custodial wallet interface and is not a financial service or broker. Fiat features are handled by licensed third-party partners under their own regulatory frameworks.

**How do I get support?**
24/7 support is available directly within the app, or via email at info@swiftexwallet.com

## Legal & Compliance
SwiftEx Wallet is a non-custodial wallet interface only. SwiftEx does not operate a financial service, brokerage, or custodian. Fiat access features are provided exclusively through licensed and regulated third-party partners operating under their own regulatory frameworks and terms. Users are solely responsible for the security of their private keys and recovery phrases.
